data.company: CÔNG TY TNHH VI TÍNH NGUYÊN KIM
data.text:
Mô tả công việc:
Tham gia phát triển và bảo trì hệ thống backend (Laravel/NodeJS/Python...)
Viết các công cụ nội bộ hỗ trợ quy trình làm việc: xử lý dữ liệu, tự động hóa thao tác, tạo báo cáo,...
Làm việc với cơ sở dữ liệu (MySQL, MongoDB...) và thiết kế API
Có kiến thức cơ bản về lập trình backend: PHP (Laravel), NodeJS hoặc Python
Biết cách làm việc với cơ sở dữ liệu và logic xử lý dữ liệu
Có đam mê phát triển hệ thống và thích xây dựng các tool hỗ trợ công việc
Có kinh nghiệm thực tế là một lợi thế, chỉ cần có năng lực và tư duy lập trình tốt
Có tinh thần chịu khó học hỏi, trách nhiệm trong công việc.
Có thể chuyển đổi giữa frontend + backend là 1 lợi thế. Làm việc với git.

Yêu cầu ứng viên:
• Tốt nghiệp Cao đẳng, Đại học chuyên ngành Công nghệ thông tin hoặc các chuyên ngành liên quan.
• Có làm qua PHP, Laravel
• Kỹ năng lập trình tốt với: PHP, MySQL, Javascript, HTML, CSS.
• Có kiến thức với MySQL và REST API.

Quyền lợi:
- Đồng phục, điện thoại, công cụ dụng cụ làm việc...
- Được đào tạo kỹ năng mềm, kiến thức chuyên môn.
- Lương tháng 13, 12 ngày phép...
- Thưởng đóng góp sáng kiến, ý tưởng mới trong công việc.
- Thưởng thâm niên 3 năm, 5 năm, 10 năm.
- Chính sách phúc lợi cưới hỏi, ốm đau, thai sản.
- Quà trong các dịp Tết, Trung thu, sinh nhật.
- Cơm canh trưa, mì gói, trứng, chà bông...
- BHXH, BHYT, BHTN, BH 24/24, Bảo hiểm cao cấp.
- Tiêm ngừa Cúm.....
- Khám sức khỏe định kỳ.
- Phòng tập GYM miễn phí.
- Du lịch hàng năm trong/ngoài nước.

data.title: Senior Java Developer
data.text:
We are looking for a Senior Java Developer to expand our Development team in Hanoi, Vietnam.

Outpost24 empowers organizations to achieve cyber resilience with a complete range of continuous threat exposure management (CTEM) solutions. Our cloud platform unifies asset discovery and management, automates security testing, and quantifies risk in business context. Executives and security teams around the world trust Outpost24 to identify the attack surface and prioritize the most important security issues to accelerate risk reduction. Founded in 2001, Outpost24 is headquartered in Sweden, with additional offices in the US, the UK, the Netherlands, Belgium, Denmark, France, Spain and Vietnam.

As a Senior Java Developer, You Will

You will be part of one of development teams developing high quality tools for our product platform. You will be part of solving the challenges, we are working with. You will also help us integrate new technology that can improve our product or smarter deployment set. Further you will have a huge impact on the product feature set and implementation. If you want to make a difference, have an impact and develop by having highly skilled people around you - this could be the opportunity for you!

What You Will Do

- Develop high quality code that is scalable, maintainable and secure.
- Be creative to help find solutions to business requirements.
- Constantly seek ways and technologies to improve our quality and performance.

data.title: Senior Java Developer
data.text:
- Work in a development team to deliver a high-quality product in an agile work environment.
- Be part of developing next generation security products.
- Make a difference for the team.

Requirements And Qualifications

- At a minimum, you should have a bachelor’s degree in Software Development or equivalent.
- Have solid understanding of the full software development life cycle.
- Have at least five (05) years’ experiences with Java development tech stack and willingness to learn other programming languages.
- Experience in SQL (PostgreSQL, SQLite, etc.)
- Experience in working with Linux
- Experience in any of the following is an advantage:
- Python and Bash
- Scalable and high availability systems (Kubernetes, Kafka, containers, ELK etc.)
- Webservices
- Microservice architecture
- Willing to work and migrate with legacy systems.
- Have excellent and analytical problem-solving skills.
- Have ability to learn quickly and manage yourself independently.
- Have strong verbal and written communication skills in English.
- Experienced in leading a development team is an advantage.

But what's in it for you?

In Return For Your Efforts, We Can Offer You

- A competitive salary package and 100% salary during probation period.
- An annual salary review and 13th month salary.
- The chance to work with experienced software engineers worldwide at market leading, innovative Scandinavian SaaS company looking to accelerate growth.

data.title: Senior Java Developer
data.text:
- Flexible working hours from Monday-Friday, no overtime.
- A modern working environment with fun colleagues and challenging tasks.
- A Scandinavian work culture: creativity, innovation, and work-life balance.
- Premium healthcare and & accident insurance: the best healthcare plan cover for employees and their children.

And so much more!

Don’t fulfil all the criteria? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to job openings unless they fulfil every single requirement. At Outpost24, we're dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, where attitude, values and willingness to learn are valued above all. So, if you're excited about this role but your professional experiences don't completely align with what we're looking for, we encourage you to apply anyway!

data.title: Python Backend Developer (Junior)
data.text:
About Endash
Endash is revolutionizing data analytics with our AI-powered data integration and visualization platform. We enable businesses of all sizes to easily build data pipelines and dashboards without requiring dedicated data teams. Our solution connects to over 500 data sources and features innovative AI tools including Text2SQL functionality and automated insight generation, allowing non-technical users to perform complex data analysis without coding knowledge.
Position Overview
We are seeking a Python Developer to join our growing team.
In this role, you will design and implement web applications using Python/FastAPI that power our data integration and visualization platform.
You will also help architect and implement technical solutions that address both business and product challenges, ensuring our applications remain consistent, high-performing, and scalable.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop robust web applications using Python/FastAPI.
Implement technical solutions to address business and product challenges.
Optimize application performance and scalability to ensure efficient operations.
Contribute to the architecture and design of highly scalable systems.
Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.

Familiarity with the following technologies: PostgreSQL, BigQuery, Redis, Kafka, Trino.
Strong SQL skills and experience with database optimization.
Upper-intermediate level of spoken English for effective communication.
Proficient in Python concurrency.
Solid understanding of containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.
Good understanding of CI/CD pipelines.
Experience in Data Engineering industry is a plus.
Familiarity with orchestration tools such as Airflow, Prefect, etc., is a plus.
Experience in distributed systems is a plus.

data.title: Product Engineer – Growth & Automation
data.text:
Now we need someone to make the platform feel intelligent and seamless — across internal tools, user-facing flows, and smart automations.
We’re hiring a Product Engineer based in Vietnam to:
• build the internal dashboards, workflows, and UI glue that keeps the company moving
• wire together frontend, automation, and backend logic as needed
• support platform growth by owning specific product slices end-to-end.

You’ll operate at the intersection of growth, automation, and product — building things that make Tocco faster, smarter, and more scalable.

Build and connect frontend flows that feel smart
→ Custom quote builders, form-based editors, onboarding wizards.

Own internal tools and dashboards
→ Track supplier activity, map user engagement, manage Unbox logistics.

Use AI to automate tedious work
→ Auto-tag suppliers with GPT, draft summaries, trigger outreach.

Plug in third-party services and APIs
→ Clerk, Supabase, Typeform, Notion API, email tools, Zapier.

Support core platform work when needed

→ Review and extend backend APIs, design simple data queries.

Make things happen fast

We’ll probably love working with you iff…
• You’ve built and shipped small products or features end-to-end.
• You’ve used React/TypeScript in real-world settings.
• You’ve connected APIs, automated workflows, or built custom tooling.

data.title: Mobile Technical Lead (iOS, Android, Kotlin, Swift)
data.text:
Are you an experienced Mobile Technical Lead looking for your next career move? Do you have a background in design & architecture and development of digital products? If so read on.

The team:
You will be part of our Digital Delivery Hub who are responsible for designing, developing and maintaining some of the most interesting and innovative digital apps within the financial services space that are at the forefront of the market. Our Hub is focused on building a world class User Experience, Design and Web / Mobile Development team that can work with the business to realise an exciting digital strategy.

The role:
We are looking for a talented Mobile Technical Lead who still does hands-on development to contribute in the development and execution of an innovative mobile banking solution in Asia. This will include the development of in-country and cross-border solutions across all facets of a mobile banking operation including customer experience and design, developing and implementing new products and services, process engineering and other functional deliverable. Risk management and technology innovation will be essential for your success.

You will be responsible for technically leading and coaching our engineers who work in cross-functional delivery teams to design and build best-of-breed mobile solutions whilst maintaining necessary support for ongoing products.

Your duties will be to:

data.title: Mobile Technical Lead (iOS, Android, Kotlin, Swift)
data.text:
- Collaborate with our technical leaders to establish a vision for our mobile engineering initiatives. Design and develop cutting-edge applications for Android and iOS platforms.
- Work closely with cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features.
- Provide coaching, guidance, and mentorship to mobile developers to facilitate their professional growth.
- Work on addressing bugs and improving application performance.
- Continuously research, evaluate, and implement innovative technologies to optimize development efficiency.
- Participate in the planning process for software development projects, ensuring adherence to quality standards and timely delivery.
- Design the architecture for new products and features.
- Provide leadership and mentorship to a team of mobile developers, offering guidance and support to achieve individual objectives and deliver high-quality code.

data.title: Mobile Technical Lead (iOS, Android, Kotlin, Swift)
data.text:
Technical Skills:
- 6+ years of experience in Mobile Development.
- 2+ years of experience as a Mobile Development Team Leader.
- Proven expertise in either iOS (SwiftUI and UIKit) or Android (Kotlin) development. While proficiency in both platforms is not mandatory, it will be a plus.
- Experience working on various mobile apps, preferably large-scale applications with multi-country targets.
- Experience with modern mobile architecture.
- Having experience in KMP(Kotlin Multiplatform) development is a big plus.
- Familiarity with backend development technologies (E.g. APIs and databases)
- Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery/continuous deployment.
- Experience with Modularization and code artifact management.

Soft skills:
- Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
- Strong willingness to learn new practices and technologies.
- Exceptional interpersonal skills, including facilitation and negotiation.
- Understanding and experience of Agile methodology.
- Experience in working across several technical domains with the ability to ‘deep dive’ where required and ensure correct solutions are implemented.
- Ability to translate technical talk to the business.
- Ability to deliver convincing presentations that provide significant insight and generate consensus and buy-in.
- Experience managing and leading a development team.

data.title: Senior Angular Developer (Typescript, UI, English)
data.text:
We are looking for a talented Senior Angular Developer to join our software development team. You will participate in international projects, developing high-quality user interfaces, integrating with backend systems, and ensuring optimal performance for our products. Open for both Fresher and Experienced candidates who are passionate about web technologies and eager to grow in a dynamic and professional environment.

For Fresher-level candidates, we offer a clear training roadmap and hands-on mentorship to help you build strong foundations and grow your career.

1. Technical Skills
Experience:
• Minimum 3–5 years of experience in software development using Angular.
• Hands-on experience in real-world projects utilizing the Angular framework, UI development, and backend API integration.
Frontend Development:
• Proficient in AngularJS/Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and libraries like RxJS, NgRx.
• Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and the MVC pattern.
• Skilled with tools such as Webpack, Angular CLI, and package managers (npm, yarn).
Integration & Development:
• Experience working with RESTful APIs, GraphQL, or similar protocols.
• Familiar with the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including architecture design, unit/integration testing, and CI/CD deployment.
• Ability to design responsive user interfaces and optimize web performance.
Nice-to-Have:
• Experience with other frameworks such as React, React Native, Vue.js, or Node.js.
